In Conclusion The hope with TinyStories is to facilitate the development, analysis, and research of language models, especially for low-resource or specialised domains, and shed light on the emergence of language capabilities in these models. sources.snippet: 🧸 TinyStories LLM - A Miniature Language Model for Storytelling A 40M parameter decoder-only transformer trained on the TinyStories dataset, designed to generate short, coherent children's stories. Inspired by the Mistral architecture, built and trained from scratch by a self-taught student exploring large language models.

sources.title: AIAny - TinyStories
sources.snippet: Notes on usage and limitations Because the data is model-generated, it inherits biases and stylistic artifacts from the generator (GPT-3.5/GPT-4). Results obtained on TinyStories are most informative about sequence modeling and sample efficiency; claims about broad language understanding should be validated on more diverse corpora.
